## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: validate-issues.sh updated with an origin:arbiter exemption: orphan-task tickets tagged orphan:deferred_review are excluded from health warnings about unlinked orphan tickets

## TDD Requirement
UPDATE tests from Task d37c-77b9-3f0f-4b2f must FAIL before this task runs and PASS after.

Turn RED → GREEN:
- test_orphan_deferred_review_tag_exempt: ticket with both orphan:deferred_review AND origin:arbiter tags must NOT produce a WARNING
- test_orphan_deferred_review_without_origin_arbiter_is_still_flagged: ticket with only orphan:deferred_review (no origin:arbiter) MUST still produce a WARNING

## Implementation Notes

### plugins/dso/scripts/validate-issues.sh

#### Step 1: Extend the normalization layer to carry "tags" through
In get_shared_issues_json() → the python3 normalization block, add "tags" to the internal issue schema:

```python
tags = t.get('tags', [])
# ...
issues.append({
    ...existing fields...,
    'tags': tags,
})
```

The internal schema currently does NOT include "tags" — this must be added for check_orphaned_tasks to access it.

#### Step 2: Add the exemption in check_orphaned_tasks()
In the python3 block inside check_orphaned_tasks(), modify the orphan detection logic:

```python
# Exempt tickets that are intentional orphan tasks with provenance tracking
tags = issue.get('tags', [])
is_arbiter_deferred = ('orphan:deferred_review' in tags and 'origin:arbiter' in tags)
if is_arbiter_deferred:
    continue  # Skip — intentional arbiter-generated orphan task, not an untracked task
```

This exemption must be:
- Scoped to BOTH tags present: orphan:deferred_review AND origin:arbiter
- Applied BEFORE the orphans list is populated (so the ticket is never counted)
- NOT a blanket exemption for all orphan:* tags

#### Scope constraint (from story consideration)
The exemption is scoped to orphan:deferred_review tag only — do NOT blanket-exempt all orphan tickets. The second test (test_orphan_deferred_review_without_origin_arbiter_is_still_flagged) enforces this: a ticket with orphan:deferred_review but without origin:arbiter is still flagged.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/validate-issues.sh: modify (add tags to normalization schema + add exemption in check_orphaned_tasks)
- tests/scripts/test-validate-issues.sh: turn UPDATE tests RED → GREEN

## Consumer Detection
- check_orphaned_tasks is called by both the quick-mode and full-mode branches in main()
- The tags extension to the normalization layer affects ALL check_* functions (they all call get_shared_issues_json)
- No other check function currently uses tags — this is additive only (no existing behavior changes)
- The python normalization block is in get_shared_issues_json() — changing the output schema there is the right place since all checks share the cache

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] UPDATE tests now PASS: test-validate-issues.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-validate-issues.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] Ticket with both orphan:deferred_review AND origin:arbiter tags does NOT trigger WARNING
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-validate-issues.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] Ticket with orphan:deferred_review but WITHOUT origin:arbiter still triggers WARNING (scope check)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-validate-issues.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"
- [ ] tags field is present in normalization layer output (get_shared_issues_json returns tags array)
  Verify: TICKET_CMD=$(mktemp) && printf '#!/bin/bash\necho '"'"'[{"ticket_id":"t1","ticket_type":"task","status":"open","title":"T","tags":["test:tag"],"parent_id":null,"deps":[]}]'"'"'\n' > $TICKET_CMD && chmod +x $TICKET_CMD && TICKET_CMD=$TICKET_CMD bash -c 'source $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate-issues.sh 2>/dev/null; get_shared_issues_json' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d[0].get('"'"'tags'"'"') == ['"'"'test:tag'"'"'], d" && echo ok
- [ ] All previously passing validate-issues.sh tests remain passing
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-validate-issues.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE "FAILED: 0\b"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add origin:arbiter + orphan:deferred_review exemption to validate-issues.sh
